component.title: Empty State
component.purpose: Explain an empty result and offer a clear next action without visual noise.

states.description: A clear next action is available.

behaviors.description: The empty state presents a clear title, optional explanation, icon cue, and next action without changing the consumer's content contract.
Plain native buttons and links receive a token-backed action treatment while governed control primitives keep their own visual contract.
The action becomes a full-width touch target on narrow viewports without changing the surrounding content order.
